subject: Geopolitics
title: The Nile Basin Dispute
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Nile Basin Dispute usable.

hook.text: Ethiopia built a massive dam on the Nile. Egypt says it threatens 100 million people who depend on the river.

buildup.text: The GERD dam will generate 6,000 megawatts. Ethiopia needs power. Egypt needs water. Both needs are existential.

discovery.text: A 1929 colonial treaty gave Egypt veto power over Nile projects. Ethiopia never signed and rejects it entirely.

twist.text: Egypt's president said all options are open — code for military action. Water disputes can escalate to war.

climax.text: Climate change will shrink rainfall across the Nile basin. The dam dispute is a preview of conflicts to come.

punchline.text: Water is the one resource no nation can live without.

quiz.question: Why does Ethiopia reject the 1929 Nile treaty?
options: The treaty was signed by colonial powers, not Ethiopia
Ethiopia was not yet an independent nation
The treaty only covered irrigation, not dams
